PREPARED: 09/08/26 - 14:19
REFERENCE ARTICULATION
PROGRAM CODE: 2012
TRANSFER PLANNING GUIDE (TPG) FOR DEGREE PROGRAM:
                        BACHELOR OF ARTS
              LETTERS ARTS & SCIENCES (UNDECLARED)
_________________________________________________________________
TRANSFER EQUIVALENT COURSES IF TAKEN IN CAT. YEAR FA26
THRU SU27, AT: Santa Barbara City College
_________________________________________________________________

_________________________________________________________________
       COMPOSITION/WRITING REQUIREMENT -- COURSE WORK MUST BE
       TAKEN FOR A LETTER GRADE:
--> NEEDS:                            2 SUB-GROUPS

     1) FIRST YEAR WRITING REQUIREMENT:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: WRIT130={*ENG111 OR *ENG111H OR *ENGLC1001
            OR *PHIL111}

     2) UPPER DIVISION WRITING REQUIREMENT (must be taken at
        USC):
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
            {NO COURSE EQUIVALENTS AVAILABLE}
_________________________________________________________________
###### IMPORTANT NOTE REGARDING FOREIGN LANGUAGE CREDIT ######

LANGUAGE COURSES AVAILABLE ONLINE/HYBRID OR VIA STUDY ABROAD
REQUIRE ADDITIONAL REVIEW AND WILL NOT APPEAR ON THIS LIST.
FOREIGN LANGUAGE CREDIT MAY BE AVAILABLE FOR THESE COURSES IF
TAKEN IN THE ON CAMPUS CLASSROOM FORMAT.  PLEASE SEE PART III OF
THE ARTICULATION AGREEMENT (OR ARTICULATION HISTORY) FOR YOUR
SENDING INSTITUTION FOR ANY LANGUAGE COURSES AVAILABLE FOR
FOR FOREIGN LANGUAGE CREDIT FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL REVIEW.

_________________________________________________________________
       FOREIGN LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT - TPG LISTING OF COURSE WORK
       THAT MEETS LEVELS I, II AND III REQUIREMENTS:

     1) LEVEL I COURSES:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:FL1={*HEBR101 OR *LATN101}

     2) LEVEL II COURSES:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:FL2={*ARBC102 OR *CHIN102 OR *HEBR102
            OR *LATN102}

   R 3) LEVEL III COURSES:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
            {NO COURSE EQUIVALENTS AVAILABLE}
_________________________________________________________________
       GENERAL EDUCATION CORE LITERACIES REQUIREMENTS -  TPG LIST
       OF COURSES MEETING GE CATEGORIES:

       NOTE:   1.  FIRST YEAR FRESHMAN AT USC MUST TAKE ONE GE
                   SEMINAR (GESM) AS ONE OF THE EIGHT COURSES.

               2.  TRANSFER STUDENTS AND FRESHMAN ADMITTED FOR
                   THE SPRING MUST COMPLETE AT LEAST TWO
                   OF THEIR EIGHT CORE LITERACY COURSES AT USC,
                   WITH A MINIMUM OF TWO COURSES OFFERED IN
                   DORNSIFE COLLEGE DEPARTMENTS.

               3.  NO MORE THAN ONE COURSE TAKEN P/NP (AT USC
                   OR IN TRANSFER) MAY APPLY TO THE CORE
                   LITERACIES.

     1) CATEGORY A - THE ARTS:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:GEA={*ART101 OR *ART102A OR *ART102B
            OR *ART103 OR *ART103H OR *ART104 OR *ART104H OR *ART106
            OR *ART108 OR *ART110 OR *ART111 OR *ART112 OR *ART210
            OR *ART211 OR *ART215 OR *ART216 OR *BLST111 OR *ENG242
            OR *FS101 OR *FS101H OR *FS104 OR *FS107 OR *FS110
            OR *FS111 OR *FS112A OR *FS112B OR *FS113 OR *FS118
            OR *FS119 OR *FS120 OR *FS121 OR *MUS110 OR *MUS114B
            OR *MUS115 OR *TA103 OR *TA106 OR *TA107 OR *TA108}

     2) CATEGORY B - HUMANISTIC INQUIRY:
         NEEDS:                 2 COURSES
        SELECT FROM: F:GEB={*BLST113 OR *CHST113 OR *ECE115
            OR *ENG221 OR *ENG222 OR *ENG225 OR *ENG226 OR *ENG226H
            OR *ENG231 OR *ENG232 OR *ENG240 OR *ENG241 OR *ENG251
            OR *ENG261 OR *ENG262 OR *HIST101 OR *HIST102
            OR *HIST102H OR *HIST103 OR *HIST104 OR *HIST107
            OR *HIST108 OR *HIST113H OR *HIST121 OR *HIST122
            OR *HIST127 OR *HIST135 OR *PHIL100 OR *PHIL100H
            OR *PHIL101 OR *PHIL101H OR *PHIL102 OR *PHIL102
            OR *PHIL102H OR *PHIL102H OR *PHIL200 OR *PHIL201}

     3) CATEGORY C - SOCIAL ANALYSIS:
         NEEDS:                 2 COURSES
        SELECT FROM: F:GEC={*AJ105 OR *ANTH102 OR *ANTH103
            OR *ANTH104 OR *ANTH109 OR *ANTH113 OR *ASAM101
            OR *ASAM102 OR *BLST101 OR *BLST102 OR *BLST102
            OR *BLST102H OR *BLST103 OR *CHST101 OR *ETHS101
            OR *ETHS101H OR *ETHS107 OR *ETHS109 OR *ETHS110
            OR *ETHS117 OR *ETHS121 OR *ETHS122 OR *GEOG102
            OR *HIST110 OR *HIST110H OR *POLSC1000 OR *POLS121
            OR *SOC101 OR *SOC101H OR *SOC107 OR *SOC109 OR *SOC127}

     4) CATEGORY D - LIFE SCIENCES:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
            {NO COURSE EQUIVALENTS AVAILABLE}

     5) CATEGORY E - PHYSICAL SCIENCES:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
            {NO COURSE EQUIVALENTS AVAILABLE}

     6) CATEGORY F - QUANTITATIVE REASONING:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:GEF={*ECON101 OR *ECON101H OR *ECON102
            OR *ECON102H OR *MATH114 OR *MATH130 OR *(MATH137 &
           138) OR *MATH149 OR *MATH150 OR *MATH160 OR *MATH200
            OR *PSY150 OR *SOC125 OR *STATC1000}

     7) CATEGORY G - EQUITY IN A DIVERSE WORLD:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:CIT={*ETHS109 OR *ETHS117 OR *POLS121
            OR *SOC127}

     8) CATEGORY H - TRADITIONS AND HISTORICAL FOUNDATIONS:
         NEEDS:                 1 COURSE
        SELECT FROM: F:THF={*ART103 OR *ART103H OR *ART104
            OR *ART104H OR *HIST101 OR *HIST102 OR *HIST102H
            OR *HIST103 OR *HIST104 OR *HIST107 OR *HIST108
            OR *HIST110 OR *HIST110H OR *HIST113H OR *MUS114B
            OR *PHIL102 OR *PHIL102 OR *PHIL102H OR *PHIL102H
            OR *PHIL200 OR *PHIL201 OR *TA107 OR *TA108}
_________________________________________________________________
The Degree Progress Advisement report has been prepared to
assist you in determining your academic progress at the
University of Southern California.  Although efforts have been
made to ensure its accuracy, the student is responsible for the
completion of all graduation requirements.

If this report does not appear to be accurate, please contact
your academic advisor, and bring this report with you. The
Office of Academic Records and Registrar along with your major
department will certify your successful completion of degree
requirements.

Any exceptions (i.e.,course substitutions, waivers, recitals,
etc.) you have had approved for your major should appear on
your STARS report. If you believe an error exists on your
STARS report, please consult with your academic advisor.

_________________________________________________________________
************************ END OF ANALYSIS ************************
